'''Allen Kerr''' (21 May 1926 – 14 December 2023) was a Scottish-born Australian biologist. He served as Professor of [[Plant pathology|Plant Pathology]] at the [[University of Adelaide]]. His most significant work was his study of crown gall — a plant cancer induced by [[Agrobacterium tumefaciens|Agrobacterium tumerfaciens]].

== Biography ==
Kerr was born in [[Edinburgh]] on 21 May 1926 Ane gained a B.Sc. degree at the [[University of Edinburgh]].

From 1947-1951 he was an assistant [[Mycology|Mycologist]] at the [[Scotland's Rural College|North of Scotland College of Agriculture]].

In 1951 he immigrated to Adelaide, South Australia to take up the position of lecturer of Plant Patholoy at  the University of Adelaide. Between 1951 and his retirement, he held several positions at the University including Senior Lecturer, Reader in Plant Pathology, Head of the Department of Plant Pathology in 1990, and Head of the Department of Crop Protection in 1990.<ref>[http://www.eoas.info/biogs/P004675b.htm Kerr, Allen (1926 - )], Encyclopedia of Australian Science, www.eoas.info</ref>

In 1978, he was elected [[Fellow of the Australian Academy of Science]].

From 1978-1983 he was Vice-President of the International Society for Plant Pathology and from 1980-1983 he was President of the Australasian Plant Pathology Society.

In 1986 he was elected [[Fellow of the Royal Society]].

In 1990 he received the inaugural [[Australia Prize]] for his work with [[plant genetics]] and biology.

Kerr celebrated his 90th birthday in 2016.<ref>{{cite web |title=90th birthdays |url=https://www.science.org.au/academy-newsletter/australian-academy-science-newsletter-104/90th-birthdays |website=Australian Academy of Science |access-date=12 March 2023}}</ref> He died in [[Adelaide]] on 14 December 2023, at the age of 97.<ref>{{cite web |title=Kerr, Professor Allen FRS, FAAS, AO |url=https://www.mytributes.com.au/notice/death-notices/kerr-professor-allen-frs-faas-ao/6154859/ |website=MyTributes |access-date=19 January 2024}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* 1978 - Fellow of the [[Australian Academy of Science]] (FAA)
* 1978 - Walter Buffitt Prize of the Royal Society of New South Wales
* 1982 - [[Ruth F. Allen|Ruth Allen]] Award of the American Phytopathological Society
* 1986 - Fellow of the Royal Society (FRS)
* 1990 - Inaugural [[Australia Prize]]<ref>[https://sciencegrants.dest.gov.au/scienceprize/Pages/Doc.aspx?name=previous_winners/Aust1990Kerr.htm 1990 Australia Prize] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070829115039/https://sciencegrants.dest.gov.au/SciencePrize/Pages/Doc.aspx?name=previous_winners%2FAust1990Kerr.htm |date=29 August 2007 }}, sciencegrants.dest.gov.au</ref>
* 1991 - Foreign Associate of the [[US National Academy of Sciences]]
* 1991 - Elvin Charles Stackman Award of the University of Minnesota
* 1992 - Officer of the Order of Australia (AO)
* 1995 - Fellow of the [[Australasian Plant Pathology Society]]
* 1996 - Fellow of the [[American Phytopathological Society]]
* 2001 - Fellow of the [[American Academy of Microbiology]]
